name: SuggestionChips
description: Prompt suggestions as glass pills: one tap puts the prompt in the composer.
signature: ({ suggestions, onSelect, align, className, ...rest }: SuggestionChipsProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Centre them (the landing) or start-align them (a scoped pane).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the suggestion whose pill is pressed; the host normally puts its `prompt` in the composer.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Initial or ranked choices offered before a search.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
